images.review: Original red arcade and grey arch rings/roof unchanged. Side window backs and stone waist bands use existing palette. Broad gable neutral is deliberate due missing true stone-base and cap boundaries, not a red diagonal patch.

Rear slope has continuous original tile-family color, with no center-selected diagonal leftovers. Dark original tall-arch backs are opaque proxies; complete original rear outer wall uses inferred brick-family proxy while arch returns remain neutral.
Original seven paired arches and color assignments intact; actual open corridor remains open with no infill or decorative geometry.
Lower front-oblique angle keeps original arcade depth and original front materials. End wall remains neutral without invented base stripe.
Existing arch and rectangular recess backs are colored, stone bands are complete original boxes; gable and buttress bodies retained neutral due true unresolved mixed finish boundaries.
Opposite original end retains its different platform and original geometry. Complete original supports colored without fake new windows or materials split across triangles.
Two original roof slopes now have same original tile-family material. Neutral side gable caps and artificial base remain; roof ridge and asymmetric footprint unchanged.
Same camera, lighting and palette; only original indices restored. Original neutral window back and stone-band assignments visible as comparison.
Same camera, lighting and palette; only original indices restored. Original neutral rear wall, roof, cornice and aperture backs show exact limited repair coverage.

limitations: Not complete facade recoloring. Significant actual end/corridor mixed finishes lack original boundaries and broad walls remain neutral. Rear wall/roof/window family finish inferred, no new complete rear image. Original scale/geometry and no physical print test retained.
